justification: 1.0 support: inherited High/Critical CVEs ship within the CVE SLA. Maps tcp/ip, nftables, cfg80211 and supplicant CVEs onto NetworkConnection and netmgr exposure and names the regression tests to run.

title: Export link, route and network Capability state to os inspect
justification: V1 daily-driving and the capability-denial demo need os inspect to show links, routes, NetworkConnection objects and held network Capabilities. OBS owns the inspect command; NET owns this data. Fills workstream observability of network objects.

title: Implement Object<NetworkConnection> over the retained TCP/IP stack
justification: §7 Object<NetworkConnection> with Connect, Accept, Send and Receive Operations on the placement chosen by decide-netconn-placement. Preserves Linux TCP/IP as the mechanism; native software never sees sockets. Needed for V1 Ethernet/Wi-Fi through capabilities.

title: Build the restartable network management service with connection profiles
justification: GAP-0291 connection profiles and INV-0595 restart/rebind: killing the network service re-establishes links or fails clients explicitly under SVC supervision. Hosted as an SVC service, not in-kernel. APP binds the shell picker to this interface. V1 daily-driving on desktop Ethernet and laptop Wi-Fi.

title: Expose network namespace isolation as a Capability-scoped primitive
justification: Synthesis NET scope: network namespaces for ENV and LNX. V1 os env creates a NetworkNamespace isolating service ports without ambient network authority. NET provides the primitive; ENV INV-0659 consumes it. Retained kernel namespaces underneath, not a rewritten stack.

title: Deliver NIC DMA receive directly into a MemoryObject
justification: INV-0322 §17: NIC DMA lands in a MemoryObject for ownership transfer to decoder/GPU. Implements spike-nic-dma on retained drivers; MEM owns DMA-compatible properties and the NIC-to-decoder transfer. No native NIC driver rewrite.

title: Provide sshd remote shell via the Linux personality with listen Capability
justification: Critique item 20 / EXTRA-020: developers need remote shell at V1. sshd runs in the Linux personality; the host listen right is an explicit network Capability, never ambient. Native typed remote shell is a later adr.

title: Inventory retained TCP/IP, nftables and network drivers under native objects
justification: Collapse NET retain-Linux items into one inventory listing TCP/IP, nftables, Ethernet and Wi-Fi drivers as the mechanism under native objects, feeding KRN's retained-mechanism list. V0 hardware is wired Ethernet only; Wi-Fi driver retention is recorded here and exercised at V1. KRN already runs networking kselftests, so NET does not add a second retain-regression task.

title: Ship folder sharing to Windows and macOS clients per the SMB-server decision
justification: Implements decide-smb-server if 1.0 ships sharing. Feature-freeze at V4 RC1 requires the server, if accepted, to exist here. Listen Capability is explicit. Dropped if the adr chooses not to ship.

title: Prototype NetworkConnection wrap versus userspace broker with measurements
justification: Critique requires an explicit V0 spike for every Layer 1 surface; Object<NetworkConnection> is a §7 kernel object. The report measures throughput and latency of wrapping retained TCP/IP versus a userspace broker so decide-netconn-placement (GAP-0538) is evidence-based. Does not freeze the surface.

title: Investigate NIC-to-MemoryObject DMA on retained drivers via AF_XDP
justification: INV-0336: feasibility of NIC DMA into a MemoryObject on retained Linux drivers (AF_XDP/zero-copy receive) before the V2 deliverable. Report documents driver constraints for MEM's NIC-to-decoder path. Does not rewrite the NIC driver stack.

title: Implement split DNS per interface and per VPN tunnel
justification: Remaining GAP-0292 clause: split DNS per interface or VPN so corporate resolvers do not leak to the public interface. Depends on vpn-tunnels and system-resolver.

title: Implement system proxy configuration applied to native and personality traffic
justification: GAP-0296 system proxy. Native TLS and resolver honour the proxy Capability; LNX GAP-0295 and WIN propagate the same settings. APP owns the settings panel.

title: Implement the system resolver with DNS-over-TLS, DNS-over-HTTPS and DNSSEC
justification: V1 gate: DNS works and must not leak plaintext when DoT/DoH is configured. DNSSEC validation is on by default for native resolution. mDNS/.local is stubbed until mdns-dnssd; split DNS per VPN is V2. SEC CA store is the trust root.

title: Run the Tier 1 Wi-Fi hardware suite on every V4 release candidate
justification: V4 hardware gate: every Tier 1 machine passes the full suite including Wi-Fi each RC. Turns V1/V2 connect, roam, suspend-restore and enterprise scenarios into a published per-machine matrix. LAB hosts the runs; NET owns the cases.

title: Verify the V1 network gate: Wi-Fi, DHCP, DNS and Capability denial
justification: Gate-verifying task for V1-G Wi-Fi/DHCP/DNS and 'a component without a network capability cannot open a connection', plus Wi-Fi up after 200 suspend cycles on the Intel laptop. Permanent CI scenarios on qemu and hw-intel-laptop.

title: Implement WireGuard tunnels and personality VPN clients as Capabilities
justification: GAP-0294: WireGuard is the native tunnel primitive; OpenVPN/IPsec/proprietary clients run in the Linux personality. Tunnels are Capabilities with per-app routing; APP owns the shell toggle. Always-on VPN must compose with decide-net-capability.

title: Implement WPA2/WPA3 enterprise, captive portals and full roaming
justification: INV-1218 and remaining GAP-0291: enterprise EAP, captive-portal login, and roaming on Intel and AMD laptops for the V2 laptop-day demo (open lid, Wi-Fi reconnects). Personal WPA2/WPA3 already landed at V1.

title: Verify Wi-Fi on community hardware via inherited drivers and the HCL probe
justification: V3 scope: Wi-Fi hardware breadth beyond target machines via inherited Linux drivers and the compatibility database. NET supplies connect/scan/DHCP scenarios the REL probe and HCL publish; HW owns chipset listing.

title: Bring up WPA2/WPA3 personal Wi-Fi with hidden networks and roaming
justification: V1 exit: WPA2/WPA3 connects, roams between two access points, and survives suspend on the Intel laptop. Implements decide-wifi-supplicant with hidden-network and captive-portal detection. Enterprise EAP is INV-1218 at V2. Retained Wi-Fi drivers, not a native MAC stack.

title: Implement wired 802.1X authentication on Ethernet profiles
justification: GAP-0296 wired 802.1X for office Ethernet at public alpha. Shares EAP machinery with wifi-enterprise-full but is a distinct link type in netmgr profiles.

title: Log and inspect AI assistant action graphs and their Capability grants
justification: V2 exit: the AI demo's full action graph is logged and revocable. Depends on SEM's semantic registry and broker tasks (§57 ordering); records into audit-log-store and appears in `os inspect` and `os trace`.

title: Expose audit log queries via os inspect for Settings and the Permissions UI
justification: Typed query interface over audit-log-store consumed by `os inspect`, the Settings app (APP) and Permissions UI v1 (SEC).

title: Build the tamper-evident size-bounded security audit log
justification: Records authentication failures, elevation grants, capability escalations, Secure Boot state changes and key enrolments as hash-chained, size-bounded records for incident response.

title: Measure tracing overhead enabled versus disabled on the IPC benchmark
justification: V0 benchmark gate: tracing overhead under 3% on the IPC benchmark; publishes the number against the ceiling set by decide-tracing-substrate.

title: Trace and inspect Capability grant, derivation, transfer and revocation
justification: V0 isolation demo requires a typed denial visible in the audit log and `os inspect capability` showing holder, target, rights, derivation chain and revocation state. Live events only; the durable tamper-evident log is audit-log-store at V2.

title: Require a Capability to read another Component traces
justification: Tracing is security-aware: no ambient payload leak; reading another Component requires a Capability. OBS substrate; SEC policy cites this.

title: Record per-grant usage history for the Permissions UI audit view
justification: V3 exit: a user can see for any application every grant and when it was used. Aggregates capability-audit-events into per-grant last-use records in audit-log-store.

title: Capture Component crashes with typed exit cause, async Task stacks and trace window
justification: Implements decide-crash-capture-format: panic, stack-overflow and OOM-abort exit causes from the supervisor, logical Task stacks, held Capabilities and the flight-recorder window.

title: Trace compositor frame timing, queueing and presentation events
justification: V0.5 compositor frame-latency and input-to-photon benchmark gates need commit, queue and scanout events in the native trace; OBS owns the event schema, GFX emits them.

title: Trace and inspect ComputeQueue dispatches, latency and completions
justification: V2 exit: `os inspect` shows the ComputeQueue for the ComputeDevice demo. INV-0455 moved from V0.5 because heterogeneous compute is out of scope before V2.

title: Capture kernel crash artifacts with symbolised Rust panic backtraces in CI and field
justification: pstore/kdump retained and wired so QEMU CI and reference hardware persist panics; KRN's watchdog and lockup detectors feed this path.

title: Define crash and panic signatures for symbolicated deduplication
justification: V3 exit: crash reports symbolicated and deduplicated within 24 hours; the stable signature over symbolised frames is part of the capture format, computed on device where symbols allow.

title: Package build-id keyed debug symbols and a symbolication tool for every build
justification: Produces debuginfo artifacts and a local symbolicator for stripped release builds; hosting the debuginfod-style server is REL's pipeline scope.

title: Decide the Component crash capture format
justification: OBS scope names 'crash capture format'. Options: minidump-compatible, native typed record with async Task stacks, core-file plus sidecar. Consumers are the SDK debugger (V1 async task stacks) and INS crash-report client (V3).

title: Decide the persistent journal record format and retention model
justification: Options: systemd-journal-compatible export format, native typed records over the trace schema, or plain structured text; sets retention, per-boot indexing and how personalities' logs are ingested.

title: Decide who may trace and inspect which Components
justification: §24 requires tracing to be security-aware; the V0.5 file-chooser demo (Image Viewer cannot see other files) would be defeated by unrestricted tracing. Depends on the SEC threat model (V0). Options: ambient debug right per session, Capability<Trace> per ResourceDomain subtree, owner-only with elevation.

title: Decide the trace event schema and export format
justification: Options: Perfetto/CTF-compatible, OpenTelemetry mapping, native binary. No V0 gate needs export (V0 only shows flow live); the V1 offline-export gate does, so this is the last rung it can sit in. GAP-0533 moved V0 to V0.5 for that reason.

title: Decide the tracing substrate and its measured overhead ceiling
justification: One decision: extend ftrace/tracepoints/eBPF, build a native per-Component structured ring, or layer a native semantic schema over eBPF. Sets the overhead ceiling that bench-tracing-overhead verifies. Depends on spike-tracing-substrates.

title: Document every field in crash dumps, journal exports and telemetry for privacy review
justification: V3 exit: crash reporting privacy review documented. OBS supplies the data inventory GOV's review and INS's consent screens depend on.

title: Write the instrumentation guide for semantic events and inspect providers
justification: SDK v1 ships at V1; third-party Components must know how to emit semantic events and register inspect providers so the inspect-review-gate is achievable outside the core team.

title: Add an always-on flight recorder with trigger-based dumps on failure
justification: Field debugging for daily-driving: low-overhead ring kept on within the overhead ceiling, dumped to the journal on Component crash, deadline miss or revocation storm; V3 crash reports attach the last trace window.

title: Derive per-display frame deadline-miss metrics across multi-monitor and VRR
justification: V2 benchmark gate: compositor frame deadline misses under 0.1% at 60 Hz. Extends compositor-frame-tracing to multiple displays and variable refresh; BEN's harness reads these metrics.

title: Generate tracing metadata from the IDL so every Channel call is observable by name
justification: IDL codegen plugin emitting event ids, method names and message types; crosses into IPC codegen but the metadata schema is OBS-owned. Needed for the V0 demo trace to show Channel<Request> by name.

title: Inspect an application's live component graph via os inspect
justification: Depends on CMP component graphs (V0.5). Renders components, channels and capabilities of one application as a graph using inspect-interface-kernel relationship edges.

title: Expose Component and Task inspection data including the awaited Operation
justification: Delivers the §64 example: name, state, memory, CPU %, held capabilities, tasks, owner TaskGroup and the Operation a suspended Task waits on.

title: Build the typed kernel inspection interface for per-object metadata
justification: V0 exit: `os inspect component|task|channel|capability|memory|resource` prints state, ownership and relationships for every live object. Enumeration per kind plus relationship edges; the CLI rendering is SDK's, the typed interface and data are OBS's.

title: Define inspection and trace schemas as versioned Layer 2 interfaces
justification: V1 freezes L2 evolution rules and ships SDK v1 tools that consume inspection data; the inspect and trace schemas must be IDL-defined versioned interfaces with the forward/backward test applied.

title: Expose Channel, Operation, MemoryObject and ResourceDomain inspection data
justification: Remaining four of the six V0 inspect kinds: Channel endpoints, message type, queue depth and blocked parties; a uniform enumerable representation of outstanding Operations per Task, Component and ResourceDomain with deadline and latency; MemoryObject size, properties, owner and mappings; ResourceDomain budgets, consumption and members.

title: Add the observability review gate requiring inspect and trace support per primitive
justification: Enforces the cross-cutting invariants where they first matter: a CI check that every registered kernel object kind has an inspect provider and lifecycle events, plus a PR review checklist item. Covers four standing rules with one gate task.

title: Expose the TaskGroup ownership tree with membership and cancellation state
justification: TaskGroup is not one of the six V0 inspect kinds; critique defers it. Needed at V0.5 for supervising service restart and structured cancellation debugging.

title: Lock inspection and trace interface versions for 1.x with evolution tests
justification: V4 exit: Layer 2 interface versions enumerated and locked, old-client/new-service and new-client/old-service tests pass for every core interface; inspect and trace schemas are among them.

title: Let platform services publish inspection data through the typed inspect interface
justification: V0.5 exit requires the accessibility tree and compositor objects to be inspectable via `os inspect`; INV-1266 extends inspect support to platform primitives, so services need a provider registration path.

title: Add privacy redaction and bug-report export to the journal
justification: Redaction rules per field class and a bug-report bundle (journal, inspect snapshot, flight-recorder dump) consumed by the INS crash-report client at V3.

title: Build the persistent structured journal with retention and per-Component attribution
justification: Durable logs from previous boots distinct from the tracing pipeline; required for V1 daily-driving issue tracking and later crash reports.

title: Assert zero leaked kernel objects after every integration test via the inspect interface
justification: Uses inspect-interface-kernel enumeration to assert no leaked Capabilities, MemoryObjects, Channels or Tasks after each integration test in CI.

title: Run nightly multi-hour soak with leak detection on reference hardware
justification: Second half of GAP-0133: multi-hour desktop soak on the reference machines with leak assertions, scheduled through the LAB soak calendar.

title: Emit lifecycle and ownership trace events for every V0 primitive
justification: Creation, destruction and owner-change events for Component, Task, TaskGroup, Channel, Capability, Operation, MemoryObject and ResourceDomain; Operation submit events carry identity, submitter and parent span. Feeds `os trace` at V0.

title: Record MemoryObject transfer history and property-change events
justification: Transfer history and property-change tracing go beyond the V0 inspect minimum; first needed when the compositor and Image Viewer pass buffers across several Components.

title: Make os trace usable for daily performance and correctness debugging
justification: V1 scope: debugging and tracing tools for daily-driving developers. Record, filter, aggregate, latency histograms, timeline view and live follow.

title: Ship the os trace first cut showing IPC flow, scheduling delays and failures
justification: V0 exit: `os trace` shows IPC flow and scheduling delays for the §59 demo. IPC flow graph between Components, wakeup-to-run per Task, Operation latency, run-queue wait and failure events (Operation errors, Component crashes, revocations).

title: Attribute kernel panics per SystemGeneration and hardware for the beta fleet dashboard
justification: V4 stability program names OBS: kernel panic rate below 1 per 1,000 machine-days. Panic reports carry generation, H-ID and signature so REL's dashboard can attribute regressions.

title: Attribute Linux-personality processes and syscalls in os trace and os inspect
justification: V1 daily-driving runs browser and IDE via the Linux personality; the L2 compatibility-overhead benchmark needs syscall-translation events attributed to the owning Component. Windows personality rides on this since Wine runs inside LNX.

title: Provide sampling profiles attributed to Task, Component and TaskGroup
justification: Critique missing requirement 31 and V1 scope 'profiler': kernel sampling with attribution to Task and Component rather than threads, flame-graph aggregation by TaskGroup, exportable alongside traces. The profiler UI is SDK's.

title: Emit ResourceDomain throttling and budget-exhaustion events
justification: V0 exposes budgets and consumption; throttling events and kernel-object-limit exhaustion (critique missing req 2) are added once SCH enforces them on real applications.

title: Expose wakeup-to-run latency histograms per Task and intent class
justification: SCH intent classes complete at V1 (Realtime); the V1 audio round-trip gate needs scheduling delay attributed to intent class, not just per Task.

title: Publish the 30-day soak leak and hang report for the release candidate
justification: 1.0 exit: 30-day release-candidate soak with zero open P0/P1. Runs leak-detection and hang-detection across the soak on the Tier 1 fleet and publishes the result.

title: Study eBPF, ftrace, Fuchsia tracing and Perfetto for the native tracing layer
justification: Precedes decide-tracing-substrate; critique requires the spikes informing V0 decisions to be explicit V0 tasks. Report compares overhead, in-kernel filtering safety, semantic-event fit and what retained Linux tooling (perf, bpftrace) can still provide.

title: Record crash-free session and kernel panic metrics locally for opt-in telemetry
justification: V3 exit: alpha telemetry from 500 machines with crash-free session rate. OBS defines and records the on-device counters; consent client is INS, intake and dashboards are REL.

title: Gate tracing and inspection behind Capabilities with payload redaction
justification: Implements decide-trace-access-policy: trace and inspect requests carry a Capability, message payloads are redacted unless the holder has rights on the Channel, and trace buffers are charged to the requester's ResourceDomain.

title: Export os trace sessions in the decided format for offline viewing
justification: V1 exit: `os trace` exports a session that can be viewed offline. Implements decide-trace-export-format including the schema registry external tools use to decode events.

title: Enable and disable tracing at runtime per primitive, Component and ResourceDomain
justification: Critique moves per-domain dynamic enable out of V0; V0.5 multi-application desktop is where selective tracing first matters. Includes in-kernel filtering so disabled scopes pay near zero.

title: Publish the 1.x stability statement for inspection and trace interfaces
justification: 1.0 exit: Layer 2 supported interface versions listed in a published compatibility document with deprecation policy; covers the inspect and trace interfaces.

title: Implement the structured semantic trace ring with runtime global enable
justification: V0 exit requires `os trace` for the demo; typed-field records named in primitive terms (Channel send, Operation complete), never free-form strings or raw kernel internals. Depends on decide-tracing-substrate.

title: Detect hung Tasks and wait cycles from waiting-on relationships and dump them
justification: V2 exit demands zero P0/P1 on the 40-scenario desktop script; hangs are the hardest class. Uses the waiting-on Operation data (INV-0383) to detect cycles and deadline overruns and emit a failure event with a wait-graph snapshot.

title: Match installed SystemGenerations against advisories and surface fixing generations
justification: V3 security response process; REL publishes advisories, PKG matches locally.

title: Add the power-cut fault-injection test for atomic SystemGeneration commit
justification: V3 updater auto-rollback and the 1.0 power-cut demo require that an interrupted update leaves either N or a complete N+1.

title: Benchmark SystemGeneration rollback time
justification: V0.5 benchmark gate: rollback time measured and published; re-cited by V3 and V4 gates.

title: Benchmark SystemGeneration switch time
justification: V0.5 benchmark gate: generation switch time measured and published.

title: Benchmark Package install time on the 20-Package corpus
justification: V0.5 benchmark gate: package install time measured and published; B-ID registered by BEN.

title: Benchmark Package-set restore time
justification: V2 benchmark gate: snapshot creation and restore time measured and published; STO owns snapshot creation.

title: Benchmark store deduplication ratio on the 20-Package corpus
justification: V0.5 benchmark gate: store deduplication ratio measured and published.

title: Decide whether application-state restore is a 1.0 goal or non-goal
justification: Depends on spike-app-state-restore; §31 ambition must be settled before V4 feature freeze.

title: Decide the content hash algorithm and chunking strategy for the store
justification: Hash identity appears in Package identifiers and signatures and cannot change later; depends on spike-store-dedup-measurement.

title: Decide dependency resolution semantics and lockfile location
justification: Exact content-hash pins vs version ranges resolved at install time; §53 forbids launch-time resolution so this must be settled before the install path is built.

title: Decide how security fixes reach a library pinned by many Packages
justification: Rebuild and republish dependents vs grafting/substitution vs runtime relinking, without global mutation; needed before REL's first CVE response.

title: Decide what is excluded from a SystemGeneration and how mutable state is separated
justification: Answers the §30 question (user data, ApplicationData, logs, caches) so rollback never touches user data; prerequisite for generation-compose and the 1.0 rollback guarantee.

title: Decide how a SystemGeneration is materialised on disk
justification: V0.5 exit requires the generation switching mechanism ADR; options: profile tree over the store, filesystem snapshot per generation, verified image per generation. Depends on STO filesystem adr.

title: Decide that Package mutation is replaced by immutable Packages and SystemGenerations
justification: §2 ADR; records the immutability invariants (no in-place mutation, no shared-filesystem writes, versioned generations) as the standing rule the immutability gate enforces.

title: Decide how immutable Packages preserve LGPL relinking rights
justification: LGPL §6 substitution must survive content-addressed packaging (dynamic linking as separate objects vs shipped object files, and how a user substitutes a modified library object in a local generation); coordinated with GOV licensing policy.

title: Decide the Package manifest schema shape and its Layer 2 evolution rules
justification: V0.5 exit requires an accepted package manifest schema ADR; critique flags the schema as a hard-to-change Layer 2 decision depending on the SEC authority-source adr and grant taxonomy.

title: Decide the on-disk and on-wire Package format and its relation to the store
justification: Content-addressed tree with manifest vs single signed archive; must be decided before the first immutable install.

title: Decide that global dependency installation is replaced by per-Package dependency objects
justification: §2 ADR deciding content-identity dependency references and the no-global-conflict invariant.

title: Decide how Linux and Windows compatibility applications are packaged immutably
justification: OCI images, Flatpak-like bundles and Wine prefixes must satisfy the no-mutation rule; V1 L2 corpus needs OCI and Flatpak.

title: Decide whether SystemGeneration switches may apply without reboot
justification: kexec vs userspace-only live switch vs reboot-only; constrains BOOT lockdown and PCR policy and the V2 update UX promise.

title: Decide which state classes are restorable at each milestone and in scope for 1.0
justification: §31 long-term ambition must be scoped before V2 restore UI work; precedes restore-package-set and selective restore.

title: Decide running-application behaviour when its Package is replaced by a new generation
justification: Critique missing requirement 17; options: old objects stay mapped until exit, restart prompt, deferred activation.

title: Decide selective restore semantics and how partial restore avoids inconsistency
justification: Restore only apps or only OS must not produce unbootable or mismatched combinations.

title: Decide the content-addressed store layout for Packages and SystemGenerations
justification: Persistent on-disk format shared by packages, generations and dev environments; V0.5 exit requires an accepted content-addressing scheme ADR. Options: Nix-style store paths, OSTree-style object repository, casync-like chunk store.

title: Decide the verified-once launch trust mechanism
justification: Cached verification of mapped package objects needs a written mechanism before V1 signed activation. verification-cache implements hash caching; system-store-verity is STO's generation verity chain. Options: dm-verity-style block verification, signed content-store index, or per-launch hash of a small manifest.

title: Implement delta object transfer for repository updates
justification: V3 scope: updater with delta updates; store-level chunk or object diff fetch used by INS updater.

title: Implement the pinned-dependency fix propagation chosen by the security-updates adr
justification: V1 signed repository delivers updates; a fixed library must reach every dependent package through the store.

title: Track and publish counts of native and personality Packages in the repository
justification: §56.5 ecosystem metric; package kind metadata in the manifest, publication with REL.

title: Add the automated boot-menu test restoring previous kernel, compositor and Packages
justification: V0.5 exit criterion and demo: install a package, roll back at the boot menu, package gone and previous state intact.

title: Compose SystemGeneration N+1 as a content-addressed tree sharing objects with N
justification: §30 update creates a new generation and leaves N intact and bootable; new generation costs only its changed objects. INS image builder consumes this.

title: Separate ApplicationData, logs and caches from the immutable SystemGeneration tree
justification: Implements decide-generation-boundary so rollback never touches user data; with STO.

title: Implement store and generation format migration for V3 to V4 upgrades with rollback
justification: V4 exit: 100 V3 installs upgraded through the update channel with rollback to V3 possible.

title: Implement SystemGeneration health states so a failed boot auto-selects the previous one
justification: V2 exit: fault-injected broken update automatically boots the previous generation on all three machines; BOOT boot counter and SVC boot-success reporting feed the state machine.

title: Pin the kernel image and modules in a SystemGeneration with BOOT selection
justification: §30; selecting a previous generation at boot must restore the previous kernel (V0.5 exit). BOOT owns the bootloader entry format.

title: Expose a typed SystemGeneration management interface for settings and rollback UI
justification: V2 exit: restore a previous generation from the settings UI; INS rollback UX (INV-1226, reassigned) and APP settings consume this interface.

title: Define SystemGeneration as the platform object naming one bootable configuration
justification: §30 fundamental abstraction; content-addressed tree with reserved signing fields.

title: Implement SystemGeneration garbage collection with user-controlled retention
justification: §30; daily-driving at V1 accumulates generations.

title: Build `os generation list|switch|previous` setting the next-boot default
justification: §60 simple system generations: create, list, boot previous.

title: Pin shell, compositor, system services and installed Packages in a SystemGeneration
justification: §30 generation contents; consumed by SVC native init to start the pinned services.

title: Record driver update and environment events in history
justification: V1 exit: `os history` lists generation, package and environment events; HW firmware update service and ENV emit through the PKG log.

title: Implement the durable typed history event log for system state changes
justification: §31 all state changes recorded as explicit typed events.

title: Record Package install, update and OS update events in history
justification: §31 event catalogue for V0.5.

title: Add the CI gate proving store and generation trees are never mutated in place
justification: Enforcing task for Principle 7 and the §30 invariants: writes into the store or active generation fail with a typed error; lint forbids mutable paths in PKG code.

title: Implement install as make-available into the store and next SystemGeneration
justification: §28 install semantics: fetch objects, register in the current or next generation, expose the launcher entry; V0.5 exit criterion.

title: Write the install and update path threat model citing the threat register
justification: V1 risk: signed repository and trust roots are security-critical; SEC owns the system threat model, PKG contributes the supply-chain section.

title: Verify Package signatures against trust roots before activation and reject tampering
justification: V1 exit: tampered package rejected (tested); fills the reserved signing fields and extends the verification cache to signatures.

title: Implement manifest Dependencies as content-addressed Package references
justification: §29 dependencies referenced by content identity, never by mutable global name lookup.

title: Declare handled content types and URL schemes in the Package manifest
justification: Manifest side of the default-application registry (GAP-0280, reassigned to SVC); V1 daily-driving needs file and link opening to route through capabilities.

title: Build the Package manifest validator and CI lint
justification: Rejects manifests that request persistent services without an explicit capability grant (§21) and enforces schema validity for the four V0.5 apps.

title: Distinguish optional from required RequestedCapabilities and support degraded launch
justification: V2 exit: capability requests denied at install while the application still launches in degraded mode where it declares optional capabilities.

title: Implement RequestedCapabilities in the manifest and launcher-time initial grant
justification: §9.1 small initial capability set granted at start; drives SEC install-time review; depends on the SEC grant-taxonomy adr.

title: Reserve signature, signer and trust-policy fields in Package and generation manifests
justification: Critique ordering fix: fields reserved before the first immutable install so V1 signing is not a breaking format migration.

title: Implement Package Resources and read-only PackageData access
justification: §25 PackageData storage object exposing bundled assets and localisation data read-only to the owning components.

title: Implement the Package manifest schema with identity, version, Components and Interfaces
justification: §28 Package definition; describes multi-component graphs with entry points, code objects, per-component capability requirements, connections and exposed typed interfaces.

title: Lock Package and generation manifest schema versions for 1.x with evolution tests
justification: V4 exit: Layer 2 interface versions enumerated and locked with old/new evolution tests.

title: Declare exposed semantic interfaces in the manifest Interfaces section
justification: §42 semantic interface v0 for Terminal and Editor at V1; SEM registry consumes the declarations.

title: Bind each Package to its own dependency versions so multiple library versions coexist
justification: §29 App A → Library 1.4, App B → Library 2.1 with no global conflict state.

title: Define Object<Package> and Capability<Package> rights including a distinct install right
justification: §7 kernel object model; install authority is a separate right so a test proves ImageDecoder and the other V0.5 apps hold no package installation authority. Coordinated with ABI and CAP.

title: Import OCI images and Flatpak bundles into the store as immutable Packages
justification: V1 L2 corpus requires an OCI container runtime and Flatpak; LNX owns the runtime, PKG owns storing layers as content-addressed objects.

title: Build `os history` listing generation, Package and environment events
justification: V1 exit: system history v1.

title: Build `os package install|remove|list` for local Package files
justification: V0.5 scope: packages installed from local files; the four apps and the demo need it.

title: Build `os restore` to a previous SystemGeneration verified after a simulated bad update
justification: V1 exit: restores kernel, packages and system configuration; CI test after a simulated bad update.

title: Build `os package build` producing deterministic content-addressed Packages
justification: Needed to produce the four V0.5 application packages; two builds of identical content yield the same identity.

title: Assemble the 20-Package benchmark corpus from native apps and dependencies
justification: V0.5 benchmark gate measures install time and dedup ratio on a corpus of 20 packages.

title: Write the Package format and manifest reference for SDK v1
justification: SDK v1 ships at V1 and developers must package applications; DOC generates IDL docs but the format reference is PKG-authored.

title: Precompute the Package load map so Components map objects without launch-time lookup
justification: §53 native startup path: resolution at build/install time, direct mapping of known objects; includes a trace-based test that launch performs no path lookup or dependency resolution. CMP performs the mapping.

title: Build `os package update|query` creating a new SystemGeneration per update
justification: §61 native package manager; update transactions land in generation N+1.

title: Store Packages, binaries, assets and dependencies as deduplicated content-addressed objects
justification: §27 object model over the STO content store; PKG owns the tree and manifest encoding, STO owns the storage substrate.

title: Build `os package publish` for third-party submission to the public repository
justification: V3 exit: third-party developer publishes a native package from the SDK; REL owns review and signing service.

title: Write the public packaging guide for native and personality applications
justification: V3 exit: public SDK guide reviewed; strangers must package and publish unaided.

title: Pin personality runtime versions per application via Package multi-version
justification: Critique missing requirement 30: multiple Wine/Proton builds coexist and are pinned per application; WIN surfaces it in UI.

title: Support content-addressed precompiled artefacts in Packages
justification: §34 prelinked images, precompiled shaders and AOT Wasm stored as objects; WASM and GFX produce them.

title: Build the repository client fetching Package objects and metadata from signed repositories
justification: V1 exit: an update delivered from the repository creates a new generation; REL owns the repository server and signing.

title: Add the two-builder identical Package identity CI check
justification: V1 self-hosting exit requires bit-for-bit image reproducibility across two machines; BLD owns build reproducibility, PKG checks identity equality.

title: Implement restore of system and application configuration from history
justification: §31; 1.0 requires `os restore` to cover configuration.

title: Implement restore of installed application set and Package versions from history
justification: V2 exit: restore a previous package set from the UI relying on content-addressed sharing, not duplicate images.

title: Refuse activation of revoked Packages and flag affected SystemGenerations
justification: V3 exit: revocation drill; client must honour revocation lists from REL.

title: Verify the update and rollback guarantee on every Tier 1 machine
justification: 1.0 exit: N ≥ 3 generations bootable, rollback preserves user data, fault-injected failure returns automatically, `os history` and `os restore` cover OS, packages and configuration; with INS and BOOT.

title: Implement running-app update behaviour and the no-mixed-version-tree test
justification: V1 update channel means packages are replaced under running components; test that no running Component observes a mixed-version tree.

title: Implement selective restore with consistency checks
justification: V2 snapshots and rollback UI exposes partial restore; depends on decide-selective-restore.

title: Share already-verified pages of identical objects across launches and applications
justification: §34/§53 deduplicated dependency objects loaded once; physical-page identity test across two applications. Depends on MEM file mapping.

title: Prototype application-state restore via checkpointing and cooperative state interfaces
justification: Evidence needed before scoping app-state restore in or out of 1.0.

title: Measure dedup ratio, update size and hash throughput on a realistic package set
justification: GAP-0525 requires measuring dedup ratio and update size before choosing the store layout; GAP-0526 needs sha256 vs BLAKE3 and whole-object vs content-defined chunking numbers. Runs on Linux package corpora so it needs nothing from V0 native surfaces.

title: Implement unreferenced store object collection safe for running Components
justification: Objects no longer referenced by any generation or mapped component are reclaimed; complements generation retention.

title: Build `os store verify` and repair for corrupted generations in recovery
justification: V3 exit: recovery environment restores a system whose current generation is corrupted; INS owns the recovery environment.

title: Study Nix, OSTree and casync stores, generations and rollback for PKG design
justification: §58 research study that informs every V0.5 PKG adr (store layout, hash, materialisation); non-gating in V0, must precede the V0.5 decisions.

title: Add the two-application conflicting-library test with dedup verified by store size
justification: V0.5 exit criterion: both run, share no mutable state, identical content deduplicated.

title: Implement uninstall as removal from the next SystemGeneration without deleting shared content
justification: §28/§30; content referenced by other generations or packages must survive.

title: Verify Package content once and cache the result keyed by object identity
justification: §34 verify once, cache aggressively; hash verification at V0.5, extended to signatures by install-signature-verification at V1.

title: Decide verified-once launch trust for cached package objects
justification: dm-verity-style, signed content-store index, or per-launch manifest hash. Must precede V0.5 immutable package mapping.

title: Package Wine prefixes as immutable base layers with ApplicationData overlays
justification: V2 Windows personality W1 gates; prefix mutation must land in ApplicationData, never in the package.

title: Attribute energy use to ResourceDomain for Settings
justification: APP GAP-0312 requires per-application energy attribution that only ResourceDomain accounting can give (§23 energy policy). PWR maps RAPL/powercap samples onto domains so Settings can list them. SCH owns budgets; this task is the meter.

title: Publish idle power draw and battery runtime on the Intel laptop
justification: V1 benchmark gate: idle power draw and battery runtime on the Intel laptop measured and published beside mainline Linux, no superiority claim. Runs B-031 under the V0.5 energy method; BEN owns the register.

title: Publish idle and mixed-workload energy on V3 laptops
justification: V3 benchmark gate: energy and battery runtime re-measured on the laptops and published (B-031). Also required for the V3 rule that every §54 item has a public number on at least one Tier 1 machine.

title: Publish idle and mixed-workload energy on every Tier 1 laptop
justification: V4 benchmark gate: idle and mixed-workload battery runtime published for every Tier 1 laptop beside mainline Linux on the same machine (B-031). Regression versus V3 per the register.

title: Publish suspend and resume latency on both laptops
justification: V2 benchmark gate: suspend and resume latency measured and published (B-030) from the cycle harness, beside mainline Linux and Windows on the same laptop where dual-boot exists.

title: Decide hibernation policy for 1.0
justification: Synthesis PWR includes hibernation policy; V2 lists hibernate as optional. Decision must precede V2 implementation. Options: no hibernate in 1.0; suspend-then-hibernate after idle; full hibernate with encrypted image. SEC GAP-0201 owns disk-key eviction; STO owns swap/hibernate layout.

title: Decide the Layer 2 power service model over retained ACPI
justification: Workstreams.md PWR scope (suspend/resume, battery, thermal, DPMS, frequency via Scheduling intent) needs a Decision before V1 implementation. Options: userspace Power Component over retained Linux ACPI; native kernel Object<Power> as Layer 1; logind-shaped native API (reject under §57). Must record that ACPI is preserved, not rewritten.

title: Decide the suspend state for V1 reference machines
justification: V1 exit requires 200 of 200 suspend cycles on the Intel laptop and 100 of 100 on the AMD desktop. Options: s2idle only; S3 only; s2idle default with per-machine S3 fallback. Depends on spike-laptop-power-paths; hibernation is a later adr.

title: Declare Layer 2 power Interface freeze candidates
justification: Ladder: Layer 2 evolution rules freeze at V1 with SDK v1; versions lock at V4. Names Power, Battery, DisplayPower, InhibitIdle and InhibitSuspend as freeze candidates citing the V0.5 spike and adr. ABI owns the surfaces register entry.

title: Enable platform idle and frequency power management on reference machines
justification: Workstreams.md: frequency via Scheduling intent (§22). V1 B-031 idle-power gate needs retained Linux runtime PM, ASPM, NVMe APST and cpufreq/EPP modes that honour SCH hints, not a rewritten governor. SCH owns hint mapping; PWR enables and constrains the platform.

title: Implement Battery reporting for the Intel laptop
justification: V1 scope: battery reporting on the Intel laptop (§61). Typed Battery Interface: charge fraction, rate, AC/DC, remaining-time estimate from platform data. APP owns the indicator; this task is the service.

title: Implement display brightness policy including ambient-light option
justification: V2 scope lists brightness. Critique item 36 (sensors: ambient-light auto-brightness) is in-or-out per HW; this task implements the brightness Interface and optional ALS path if HW leaves the class in. APP owns the slider.

title: Implement charge thresholds and power profiles
justification: V2 scope: batteries and power-profile policy. Charge start/stop thresholds, low-battery actions (notify, dim, suspend), and performance/balanced/power-saver profiles mapped onto ResourceDomain energy policy that PWR reads as frequency and idle ceilings. APP GAP-0312 is the Settings UX.

title: Implement display power management tied to idle, lock and lid
justification: Critique item 21 / EXTRA-021: DPMS, panel self-refresh, idle dim and off tied to idle, lock and lid state at V1. Consumes Session idle/lock from SEC and lid events from HW; GFX retains KMS. Full lid-close-to-suspend policy is V2.

title: Deliver the accepted hibernation policy on V2 laptops
justification: V2 scope: hibernate optional. Implements the V1 hibernation Decision: either a tested suspend-then-hibernate/full-hibernate path on both laptops, or inspectable unsupported status with no hibernation image in use.

title: Implement InhibitIdle and InhibitSuspend Capabilities
justification: Incoming reassign GAP-0285: idle and sleep inhibition as Capability<InhibitIdle> and Capability<InhibitSuspend> granted per app, listed by inspect, replacing ambient D-Bus inhibitors for native software. LNX owns UPower/logind shims; APP owns shell visibility of the list this Interface exports.

title: Implement lid, dock and external-display power behaviour
justification: Synthesis: lid/dock/external-display power behaviour. V2 laptop-day demo: open lid, close lid, resume; external display at a different scale. Policy: blank versus suspend on lid with and without external displays; dock undock. LAB automates the events.

title: Implement the Power Component with suspend and shutdown Operations
justification: V1 scope and §61 require power management as a native service. Implements the accepted Layer 2 Power Component: suspend, resume, shutdown and reboot as Operations, restartable under SVC, called by SVC shutdown sequencing. Native software never sees logind.

title: Implement suspend and resume cycle gates on laptop and desktop
justification: V1 exit: suspend/resume succeeds in 200 of 200 automated cycles on the Intel laptop and 100 of 100 on the AMD desktop, with Wi-Fi, display and audio functional afterwards. Owns the RTC-wake cycle harness, wake-source policy (lid, power button, RTC; USB wake off by default) and post-resume checks that MEM and TSK hook.

title: Implement thermal policy with capacity-loss signal to ResourceDomain
justification: V2 scope: laptops thermal. Synthesis PWR owns thermal management. Trip points, cooling and a capacity-loss signal that SCH-@thermal-intent-coordination consumes so Background and Throughput shrink first. HW owns thermal-zone drivers and function keys.

title: Expose battery, thermal, inhibit and suspend state through inspect
justification: V1 daily-driving and the suspend/battery gates are unverifiable without inspectable power state. PWR supplies the data OBS renders via os inspect: Battery, inhibitors, suspend state, wake sources and governor. SDK owns the command surface.

title: Prove battery estimate accuracy against measured runtime
justification: V2 exit: battery estimate within the register tolerance of measured runtime on both laptops. Calibrates remaining-time against B-031 discharge runs and fails CI when estimate error exceeds the gate.

title: Publish energy numbers versus Linux and Windows on 1.0
justification: 1.0 exit: every §54 metric published for every Tier 1 machine against Linux and Windows where dual-boot exists; energy gate is idle and mixed-workload battery runtime (B-031) with no superiority claim without the table.

title: Run the V2 suspend cycle gate on both laptops
justification: V2 exit: 500 automated suspend/resume cycles per laptop with the milestone success rate and full function after. Extends the V1 harness onto the AMD laptop and both Intel and AMD lid/dock paths; LAB owns the physical rig.

title: Prove Tier 1 suspend on the 1.0 soak and HCL
justification: 1.0 definition and HCL: every listed Tier 1 feature works, including suspend and resume. Confirms the soak fleet has no open P0/P1 suspend defects and that HCL entries name the verified suspend path.

title: Prototype the energy measurement method against Linux on the Intel laptop
justification: Critique: the V1 battery gate needs the energy methodology and power meters at V0.5. Synthesis gives PWR energy measurement methodology with BEN; this spike defines meter placement, idle and mixed workloads, and comparison-image rules before B-031 is published. LAB owns meter procurement.

title: Probe suspend, battery, thermal and frequency paths on reference machines
justification: Critique ordering: laptop procurement and PWR bring-up must be V0.5 so the V1 Intel-laptop suspend and battery gates are not a cliff. Report s2idle versus S3, cpufreq drivers, battery and thermal sysfs, and lid/power-button events on the Intel laptop and AMD desktop without gating V0.5.

title: Prototype Layer 2 Power, Battery and inhibit Interface shapes
justification: Freeze discipline: explore Layer 2 power Interfaces before V1 freeze candidates; no Layer 1 freeze before V4 and PWR has a V0 cap of zero. Prototypes Power, Battery, DisplayPower, InhibitIdle and InhibitSuspend over Channels so the service-model adr is not a paper decision.

title: Verify suspend, battery and thermal on V3 Tier 1 machines
justification: V3 hardware scope adds an NVIDIA desktop and one extra laptop per vendor. Re-runs the suspend harness, battery reporting, thermal policy and lid/dock paths on every new Tier 1 machine so energy republish is not on unproven suspend.

title: Verify the suspend cycle gate on every V4 Tier 1 machine
justification: V4 exit: every Tier 1 machine (at least ten named) passes the hardware test suite including suspend/resume at the milestone cycle count and success rate each RC.

title: Decide whether the repository accepts publisher prebuilts or rebuilds every Package
justification: Release-engineering and channel integrity Decision before public third-party packages.

title: Automate release qualification as a CI checklist
justification: Mechanical gate: milestone gates green, reproducibility, Tier 1 hardware, no unexplained benchmark regressions, upgrade and rollback chains. Implements decide-release-readiness.

title: Publish crash-free-session and boot-success rates per channel
justification: 1.0 stability gate: crash-free-session and boot-success rates that stable-channel generations must meet. Targets and method live in the benchmark register; this publishes the soak measurement.

title: Publish inherited-CVE time-to-generation measurements
justification: V3 security-response gate requires inherited High/Critical CVE latency measured and published. Target lives in the benchmark register (BEN); this harness records time from disclosure to a shipped generation.

title: Build once, sign and promote identical release artifacts
justification: Generation images, installer media, repository and SDK must be signed once and promoted through channels without rebuild, or testing that justified promotion is void. BLD produces; REL signs and publishes.

title: Build a download site with signatures and verification instructions
justification: Public alpha begins with a verifiable download: signature files, checksums and mirror or torrent distribution consistent with decide-distribution.

title: Build the publisher submission, review and signing pipeline
justification: V3 public repository must gate submissions: identity enrolment, manifest and Capability lint, malware and license scan, reproducibility check, human review and appeal. SDK publish tool is PKG; REL is the service.

title: Deliver a rotatable trust store inside SystemGenerations
justification: A leaked release key must be replaceable with a normal update before public alpha enrolls devices. Lands in generations composed by PKG.

title: Collect opt-in Personality compatibility reports
justification: V3 community compatibility reports into the public database: app identity, Personality version, result, workarounds. Extends publish-compat-corpus with user submissions.

title: Build crash deduplication, grouping and a triage dashboard
justification: V3 exit: reports appear in the tracker within a bounded window, linked to SystemGenerations and task IDs. Completes the REL end-to-end pipeline.

title: Decide origin, CDN and volunteer-mirror topology
justification: Public alpha volume exceeds a single origin. Records the 1.0 nongoal of a project-owned global mirror network: CDN plus verified volunteer mirrors, with health checks that cannot tamper signed metadata.

title: Define hardware support tiers as the HCL unit
justification: §62 constrains target hardware; V2's three machines seed Tier 1. The HCL unit must exist before the V3 community database. HW owns probes; REL owns the published tier schema.

title: Decide publisher identity and Package naming
justification: A public repository without namespace ownership, key attestation and a name-squatting rule cannot stop impersonation. Trademark policy remains GOV; this ADR fixes the operational identity scheme.

title: Declare fleet-management and paid-app non-goals for 1.0
justification: Collapse REL 1.0 nongoals into one ADR before the public repository: no MDM/fleet provisioning (SEC already scopes out directory join) and no paid applications or payouts. Options are defer versus build a store commerce stack.

title: Define release-readiness gates and freeze policy
justification: V3 public releases need blocker definition, go/no-go roles and per-channel freeze rules so qualification is not renegotiated under time pressure. Feeds automate-qualification.

title: Decide release, SystemGeneration and channel versioning
justification: Packages and generations need one public vocabulary before the first immutable install; ABI/SDK keep Layer evolution rules. Options include generation counters plus channel names versus semver for every artifact. Earliest dependents are V0.5 PKG manifests and the V1 signed repository.

title: Define repository curation and free versus non-free channels
justification: V3 ADR for repository review and revocation; Steam and proprietary drivers need an explicit non-free channel with consent. Options include full human review versus automated scan plus audit.

title: Decide repository retention of past generations
justification: Rollback and restore promises are only honest if referenced objects remain downloadable. Bounds the 1.0 N-previous-generations guarantee and PKG garbage collection.

title: Decide the repository model and source trust display
justification: Curated store versus open repository versus third-party repos and sideloading shapes Package identity, signing and the permissions UI before third parties publish at V3. V2 store client needs the trust-level display contract.

title: Decide the signing key hierarchy and custody model
justification: Every update, rollback and later Secure Boot chain rests on an offline root, per-channel intermediates and publisher keys; the shape must be fixed before V1 devices enroll trust. Options include HSM-backed threshold root versus software-held root with delayed HSM.

title: Decide Package and SystemGeneration signing scheme
justification: V1 exit requires a signed repository and trust-root ADR; pulled from V2 so the scheme exists before the first signed artifacts. Options include a simple signed index now with TUF roles at V3 versus TUF from the first channel.

title: Decide release cadence, LTS window and support lifecycle
justification: V4 support-policy drafts: time-based versus feature-based cadence, LTS window, which layers receive backports, security-only phase and EOL communication. The 1.0 support promise is this ADR accepted.

title: Decide whether releases use a transparency log
justification: Binary transparency is the defence against a compromised pipeline shipping targeted builds; decide Sigstore/Rekor-style logging and client inclusion proofs before the public repo hardens. Operate the log at V4.

title: Define update channels and promotion criteria
justification: V1 daily-driving needs a nightly channel and a written path to testing and later stable/LTS, including soak and who may promote. V3 channel-policy ADR is this decision landed early.

title: Define release infrastructure as code with a status page
justification: Repository or CDN outages block updates for the installed base. Records whether REL infrastructure itself must run on JakeOS (V3/V4, not V2 per critique CI-on-self ordering).

title: Define root signing key ceremony, quorum and rotation
justification: Production keys for public alpha need ceremony, HSM storage, signing quorum, rotation, revocation and named governance roles. Implements decide-signing-hierarchy for the public root.

title: Execute a signing-key rotation drill on the testing channel
justification: V4 exit: signing-key rotation drill on testing without breaking updates, using the generation trust store. Verifies operate-signing-keys and build-trust-store.

title: Rehearse third-party submit, review, sign, publish and revoke
justification: V3 exit: a third-party submission is reviewed, signed, published and revoked in a drill, and packages from outside the core team are in the repository. Verifies the publisher pipeline and emergency pull.

title: Exercise the security-response process with public postmortems
justification: V3 exit: process exercised via at least two real or simulated advisories with public postmortems. Verifies publish-disclosure-policy, the advisory feed and embargo handling.

title: Expose a repository search and metadata API
justification: V2 native-repository gate: the store client shows declared Capabilities, publisher, SBOM and compatibility before install. APP consumes this API.

title: Publish fleet crash-free and panic-rate dashboards
justification: V4 fleet gate and demo: opt-in machines, crash-free session rate and kernel panic rate published. Extends operate-telemetry-intake and crash-dedup-dashboard; targets live in BEN.

title: Generate release notes from tasks and generation diffs
justification: Desktop-preview users need hardware-facing changelogs; the task repository and generation diff already hold the facts. Reused for V3 alphas and the 1.0 notes task.

title: Ship a hardware probe that produces anonymized fingerprints for the HCL
justification: Feeds the compatibility database and HCL. REL owns publication; SDK may wrap the CLI.

title: Implement nightly and testing update channels
justification: V1 scope is a signed remote repository and the first update channel for daily-driving developers; implements decide-update-channels for nightly and testing only. Stable waits for V4.

title: Implement emergency generation and Package withdrawal
justification: Security response must withdraw a published generation or malicious Package without violating anti-rollback, mark affected generations, and coordinate third-party disclosure. PKG-@revocation-enforcement is the client.

title: Implement staged rollouts with automatic halt on crash rate
justification: A bad kernel or compositor generation must stop before the whole installed base. Halt thresholds cite the fleet telemetry B-IDs, not prose numbers.

title: Implement TUF-style repository metadata roles
justification: Signed Packages alone do not stop replay of an old valid generation. Root/targets/snapshot/timestamp roles make stale and mix-and-match metadata detectable by clients.

title: Automate CVE ingestion against the forked kernel tree
justification: §56.4 makes inherited-CVE response a permanent cost; REL opens tracked tasks with policy deadlines while KRN owns backport. Required as soon as the fork is daily-driven.

title: Build the crash-report intake pipeline from Component state
justification: Moved from V2: V2 scope-out lists the crash pipeline, and the V3 gate requires symbolicated, deduplicated reports. Critique TEL split: OBS captures, INS consents, REL intakes structured Component, TaskGroup, Capability graph and trace context. Symbol server remains BLD/OBS.

title: Join pre-disclosure lists and name embargo holders
justification: Without linux-distros and vendor programs the fork learns of kernel and GPU/browser issues at the same time as attackers. Names who may hold embargoed information.

title: Sign and launch the 1.0 stable channel with the final HCL
justification: 1.0 scope: final signing, stable channel launch and final HCL publication for Tier 1 and community Tier 2 with a promotion path. Reuses operate-stable-channel and publish-hcl.

title: Maintain SBAT generation numbers and run shim-review if chosen
justification: If BOOT chooses shim (GAP-0021/0179), REL runs shim-review and maintains SBAT numbers so compromised bootloader or kernel builds revoke without dbx churn. No-op path if shim is rejected.

title: Publish trailing inherited-CVE response against the SLA
justification: 1.0 support commitment: trailing inherited High/Critical CVE response meets the published SLA for the required fraction, distribution published. Uses bench-cve-response and register-cve-sla.

title: Operate a signed developer repository that rejects tampering
justification: V1 exit: packages are content-addressed, signed, verified before activation; a tampered package is rejected and a repository update creates a new SystemGeneration. Implements decide-signing-scheme with development keys.

title: Operate HSM-backed signing for kernel, generations and Packages
justification: §63 secure signing: offline root, HSM intermediates for bootloader, kernel, SystemGenerations, Packages and repository metadata, with documented rotation and a compromise runbook.

title: Operate the stable channel and LTS branch infrastructure
justification: V4 REL scope: stable channel infrastructure and LTS branch policy implementation from decide-support-lifecycle and decide-update-channels.

title: Operate opt-in telemetry intake for crash-free and boot rates
justification: V3 gate: opt-in telemetry from the alpha fleet with crash-free session rate measured and published. Depends on GOV policy (GAP-0360/0320); REL stores only consented schema and feeds staged rollouts.

title: Operate a public transparency log for signing actions
justification: Beta users need independently auditable evidence that signing keys were not misused. Implements decide-transparency-log; clients verify inclusion proofs on the stable path.

title: Promote consecutive alpha SystemGenerations through channels
justification: V3 updater gate: consecutive alpha releases delivered through the update channel using build-artifact-pipeline promotion without rebuild.

title: Publish 1.0 release notes and the V3/V4 migration guide
justification: 1.0 scope: release notes and migration guide from V3/V4 installs. Generated from generate-release-notes plus a written migration path; no performance claims without BEN links.

title: Publish machine-readable security advisories and a feed
justification: OSV and CSAF/VEX so the updater and third-party scanners can match exposure. PKG-@advisory-matching-client consumes the feed.

title: Publish AppStream catalogue metadata for the repository
justification: Linux-personality software centres and offline media must consume the repository without a second catalogue. Mirrorable alongside the native metadata API.

title: Publish a versioned application compatibility corpus
justification: V2 L3/W1 gates need a public per-generation pass/fail corpus fed by CI. LNX/WIN own scenarios; REL publishes the product database.

title: Publish corresponding source beside every binary generation
justification: Critique LIC fold: corresponding-source publication is REL. GPLv2 §3 begins at the first public binary; map commits, patches, scripts and toolchain beside the channel and from os history.

title: Publish vulnerability disclosure policy and signed advisory format
justification: §56.4/§63 public security response: contact, embargo, signed advisories covering kernel fork, bootloader, Personalities and the package repository. SEC owns CNA/SECURITY.md; REL owns the operational policy for distributed artifacts.

title: Publish the hardware compatibility database with community reports
justification: §63 and V3 exit: HCL with Tier 1 plus community submissions. HW owns probe tools (GAP-0146/0470); REL publishes and accepts reports under decide-hardware-tiers.

title: Publish the third-party notices bundle for every generation
justification: workstreams.md REL scope includes the notices bundle; critique LIC fold sends publication to REL. INS GAP-0014 is the About UI that displays the bundle REL ships.

title: Publish a public Package repository with integrity verification
justification: §63 and V3 exit: public repository with mirrors and integrity verification. Implements decide-distribution; clients verify TUF metadata and signatures.

title: Publish SBOM and signed provenance for every release artifact
justification: BLD generates SBOMs (GAP-0352); REL publishes signed SLSA-style provenance covering vendored crates, inherited Linux sources and firmware blobs for the public supply chain.

title: Qualify in-place V3 to V4 upgrades through the update channel
justification: V4 exit: community V3 installs upgrade with user data preserved and rollback to V3 possible. REL promotes the artifacts; INS/PKG apply generations.

title: Set published security-response targets per stable release
justification: 1.0 is judged on patch latency; the target is a register entry, not a number in this task. V4 support-policy drafts include the CVE SLA that 1.0 then meets.

title: Write and rehearse supply-chain incident runbooks
justification: Compromised signing keys, build infrastructure or repository hosts need rehearsed recovery, not improvisation while users are exposed. Complements operate-signing-keys.

title: Run organized pre-release testing of installer, updater and rollback
justification: Structured community rounds with published cases for installer, updater, rollback and Personalities catch hardware the lab matrix misses before each stable.

title: Soak the 1.0 release candidate on Tier 1 and the beta fleet
justification: 1.0 exit: release-candidate soak on the full Tier 1 fleet and beta fleet with no open P0/P1. REL owns the soak channel and go/no-go against decide-release-readiness.

title: Specify the repository wire protocol and metadata format
justification: PKG-@repository-client cannot be built without a content-addressed, chunk-fetchable, statically mirrorable server contract. §27 content addressing is the integrity model.

title: Measure delta versus full SystemGeneration update sizes
justification: Pulled from V2 so the delivery choice precedes INS chunk-level deltas and V3 delta-update gates. Measures on the PKG store format; does not restate a size target.

title: Define and CI-test supported upgrade paths between stables
justification: 1.0 users must reach later 1.x without reinstall. N to N+1 and skip-version paths run in CI on real generation histories, honouring decide-repo-retention.

title: Benchmark audio-callback jitter under LowLatency and Realtime intent
justification: Harness with a periodic audio-like callback under mixed load publishing jitter and missed-period counts per intent class beside PipeWire on Linux; complements AUD's round-trip latency gate at V1 and is reused by irq-affinity-lowlatency.

title: Benchmark Interactive latency while a Throughput build runs
justification: Compile-while-typing harness: full parallel kernel build under Throughput intent while measuring keystroke-to-render latency of the editor; published beside Linux nice on the same machine and part of the V1 self-hosting story.

title: Benchmark ResourceDomain enforcement accuracy and per-domain overhead
justification: Harness that creates a domain with CPU and memory budgets, attaches Components, and publishes share accuracy under contention, budget hit behaviour, creation cost and per-domain overhead on QEMU and the reference desktop. Verifies the V0 ResourceDomain exit criterion and supplies the overhead number the substrate adr cites.

title: Benchmark wakeup latency per intent class under contention
justification: §54 tracks latency and the V0.5 frame-time p99 gate depends on Interactive/Deadline behaviour; harness publishes wakeup latency p50/p99 for each class against a Background and Throughput flood, beside Linux nice/SCHED_FIFO on the same machine. Re-run by every later 'no regression >10%' gate.

title: Benchmark Interactive and Deadline latency under a scripted mixed desktop workload
justification: V2 gate: compositor frame deadline misses under a scripted mixed desktop workload below 0.1% at 60 Hz. Harness runs build, indexing, sync and a game concurrently and publishes per-intent latency and deadline-miss rates on all three target machines beside Linux.

title: Implement budget exhaustion handling and owner notification per ResourceDomain
justification: Implements the chosen exhaustion policy for memory, CPU and object limits, with typed errors, throttling and an owner-visible event Channel so SVC supervision can restart or shrink a misbehaving service; fault-injection tests per budget kind.

title: Run the compositor under Deadline intent aligned to display vblank
justification: With GFX: compositor frame Task declares a per-vblank Deadline and Interactive default; verified against the V0.5 zero-dropped-frames idle capture and commit-to-scanout latency benchmark.

title: Decide behaviour on ResourceDomain budget exhaustion and owner reporting
justification: Answers the §23 question: memory reclaim, throttling, typed Operation failure, or Component termination per budget kind, and how the owner is notified. Needed before packages and system services run under real budgets in V0.5.

title: Decide hierarchical versus flat ResourceDomains and budget delegation via Capability
justification: One decision: nested budgets with parent enforcement versus a flat set, and how budgets are delegated and attenuated through Capability<ResourceDomain>. Shapes the V0 kernel object and must precede domain-kernel-object.

title: Decide ResourceDomain over cgroup v2 controllers versus native accounting
justification: One decision: cgroup v2 as internal implementation detail (Phase C) versus native accounting, with measured per-domain overhead from the enforcement benchmark. Records the standing rules that accounting is native and applied to every Component and Task and that cgroup configuration is never a semantic step for native software.

title: Decide intent and priority inheritance across Channel handoff
justification: Answers the §22 question of how a LowLatency client calling a shared service avoids queueing behind Background work: per-request intent propagation, receiver-side boosting, or dedicated service Tasks. Must precede the V0.5 compositor and service restart work.

title: Decide how intents map onto Linux scheduler mechanisms versus a native class
justification: One decision, fed by spike-intent-routes: express intents through EEVDF nice/latency-nice, SCHED_DEADLINE, FIFO/RR, uclamp and cgroup cpu controllers, or introduce a native class. Records the invariant that the native interface expresses intent not numeric priority and the Phase A rule that the Linux scheduler is retained with intent layered on top. Surface state stays prototyped; nothing L1 freezes in V0.

title: Decide which ResourceDomain and intent surfaces are Layer 1 freeze candidates
justification: Critique: L1 surfaces are prototyped through V0, freeze candidates at V1 with SDK v1, frozen at V4. One decision: which domain and intent operations sit in Layer 1 versus the Layer 2 policy-profile schema, recorded as S-entries.

title: Make Operation completion wake the awaiting Task and schedule TaskGroups directly
justification: Completion of an Operation makes the awaiting Task runnable with no polling or extra wakeup syscall, and a new Component's TaskGroup is enqueued directly with no process bootstrap (§53 isolation step 5). Both are on the V0 §59 demo path and feed the component-creation and IPC benchmark gates.

title: Export per-ResourceDomain usage and scheduling-delay data for inspection
justification: V0 exit needs `os inspect resource` first cut; the critique moves broader observability to V0.5. Provides typed per-domain CPU, memory, object-count and wakeup-delay data over a Channel for OBS `os inspect`/`os trace` and the later shell resource view.

title: Enforce ResourceDomain CPU policy: share, quota, allowed cores
justification: V0 exit criterion: a 25% CPU share enforced within ±5% under contention over 10 s. Implements share, quota and allowed-core set on the substrate chosen by decide-domain-substrate; the intent field of the CPU policy is filled by intent-core-classes.

title: Implement ResourceDomain delegation and attenuation through Capability
justification: Implements decide-domain-hierarchy: a holder of Capability<ResourceDomain> derives child domains whose budgets are attenuated and enforced against the parent. Needed for the launcher to place each V0.5 app in its own domain and later for `os env`.

title: Add ResourceDomain energy policy influencing frequency and core selection
justification: Domain-level energy policy (performance, balanced, efficient) that PWR reads for frequency governors and that biases core selection; V2 laptops gate on battery estimate and mixed-workload runtime.

title: Add ResourceDomain GPU budget enforced through graphics and compute queues
justification: GPU time share and GPU memory budget per domain enforced via the DRM scheduler and MemoryObject charging; V1 GPU acceleration for Linux browser and IDE makes GPU contention real.

title: Add ResourceDomain I/O budget for bandwidth and IOPS of storage Operations
justification: Per-domain bandwidth and IOPS limits on the io controller or native accounting per the substrate adr; needed so `os env` builds and indexing cannot saturate the disk during daily driving.

title: Implement ResourceDomain as a Capability-referenced kernel object
justification: Creates the fundamental accounting object in one kernel operation (§53 isolation step 1), referenced only by Capability<ResourceDomain>; every Component is a member and every Operation is attributed to its domain for CPU, I/O and memory accounting. Exposes per-domain counters and scheduling-delay tracepoints for the V0 `os inspect resource` and `os trace` gate.

title: Add ResourceDomain latency policy setting default intent and deadlines
justification: Latency policy on the domain supplies default intent and deadline parameters to member Tasks so applications rarely set per-Task intent; used by packaged domain profiles.

title: Enforce the ResourceDomain memory budget for member Components
justification: V0 exit criterion: a Component in a domain with a 64 MiB budget cannot exceed it. Charging covers anonymous memory and MemoryObjects owned by the domain; over-budget allocation returns a typed error until the V0.5 exhaustion adr refines the behaviour.

title: Add ResourceDomain network policy applied to network Capabilities
justification: With NET: allowed connectivity and bandwidth on the domain, enforced when a network Capability is exercised; V1 exit requires that a Component without a network capability cannot connect and `os env` gets network namespaces.

title: Bound kernel-object consumption per ResourceDomain with typed exhaustion errors
justification: Pids-controller equivalent for handles, Tasks, Channels, MemoryObjects and outstanding Operations so a runaway Component cannot exhaust kernel memory; needed for the V0 100,000-component leak test to be meaningful and for the V0 fault demo.

title: Define typed ResourceDomain policy profiles for packages and services
justification: V0.5 packages declare requested capabilities and SVC supervises services; profiles give each package or service a declared domain budget, intent and latency policy so restarts (compositor crash-rebind gate) recreate identical domains. Layer 2 schema, versioned, not frozen.

title: Replace nice, chrt and cpuset tuning with ResourceDomain policy in the SDK
justification: SDK exposes only intent and domain policy; no nice/chrt/cpuset entry points in native crates. Native apps and services (the four V0.5 apps, compositor) declare policy through their domain.

title: Add ResourceDomain storage quota over the domain's persistent objects
justification: With STO: quota accounting over content-store and user objects owned by the domain, surfaced as typed errors; required before third-party packages and environments consume disk in V1.

title: Make ResourceDomain subsume cgroup isolation and accounting for native software
justification: Native components, packages and services never touch cgroupfs; domain creation drives controllers internally (or native accounting per the adr). Filesystem-diff test proves no native path writes cgroupfs; required before native init and SVC supervision at V0.5.

title: Run battery-powered sync tasks under EnergyEfficient intent
justification: Sync and background network work on battery prefers efficient cores and low frequency; measured within the V2 mixed-workload battery runtime gate on both laptops.

title: Tune EnergyEfficient intent and energy policy on every Tier 1 laptop
justification: V4 gate publishes idle and mixed-workload battery runtime for every Tier 1 laptop beside mainline Linux; tunes per-machine EPP and core-selection tables and records results without superiority claims.

title: Run game render threads, including Windows personality games, under latency intent
justification: With WIN and GFX: Wine/Proton render and present threads inherit a LowLatency intent within the game's domain; verified by the V2 W1 gaming FPS and frame-time publication against Linux+Proton.

title: Implement intent inheritance across Channel handoff for shared services
justification: Implements decide-intent-inheritance in the Channel fast path and service runtime so compositor and file-chooser requests from Interactive clients are served at the caller's intent; regression test with a Background flood.

title: Run indexing services under Background intent preempted by Interactive work
