justification: §49 native input through the personality. Gamepad/XInput is xinput-dinput; this task is HID keyboard/mouse/pointer and focus.

title: Integrate Windows applications into the native desktop chrome
justification: §62 Windows applications on the native desktop. APP owns taskbar/launcher (INV-0921/0922); WIN supplies window identity, PE icons and no-separate-desktop chrome.

title: Map Credential Manager and DPAPI onto the native secrets service
justification: W1 games and productivity store credentials via DPAPI. LNX GAP-0224 names the shim; WIN implements the Wine Credential Manager/DPAPI path with per-application scoping.

title: Publish a no-circumvention DRM and anti-tamper policy
justification: Compatibility work never circumvents DRM or anti-tamper; documents DMCA 1201 and EU equivalent exposure before public alpha gaming claims.

title: Integrate DXVK for Direct3D 9, 10 and 11 translation
justification: §48/§56.2 D3D9/10/11 via DXVK onto native graphics abstractions (GFX RenderQueue). VKD3D is a separate task.

title: Launch a .exe by double-click as a normal application window
justification: V2 exit and demo: double-click .exe, native chrome, no intermediate UI, no wizard. APP owns which formats are openable (INV-0930) and taskbar/launcher entries.

title: Translate Windows filesystem semantics onto native storage
justification: §48 FS path: case-insensitivity, drive letters, share/lock, path length, confined to the personality view. Implements casefold-view; STO owns the view API.

title: Run ten Gold W1 titles with HDR or VRR and gamepad input
justification: V2 gaming proof-of-concept and demo. Named titles; FPS published by BEN B-027 against Linux+Proton on the same hardware, no superiority claim.

title: Run Wine tests and the W1 smoke Corpus on GPU lab machines
justification: Wine conformance plus curated Windows app/game smoke corpus on GPU-equipped lab machines nightly. V1 wine-test-ci is CPU/QEMU only.

title: Wire Vulkan present, explicit sync and fullscreen scanout
justification: §56.2 GPU integration: Vulkan device access, explicit synchronisation, present timing, fullscreen/direct scanout. Consumes GFX immediate-presentation and personality GPU path.

title: Pass HDR metadata from DXVK and VKD3D to the native Surface
justification: V2 gate: at least 10 Gold W1 titles exercise HDR or VRR. Consumes GFX-@hdr-surfaces-for-personalities.

title: Bridge Wine IMM32 and TSF onto the native input-method host
justification: V4 CJK gate requires IME in compatibility windows. LNX GAP-0255 names the Wine IMM32/TSF path; WIN implements it so one IME types into every window.

title: Register prefix installers as launcher-visible installed applications
justification: Implements installer-model: setup.exe that writes a prefix becomes a launcher entry and a system-history event. APP consumes the entries.

title: Decide how prefix installers become installed applications
justification: Question: setup.exe writing into a prefix versus launcher and system history. Options: treat the prefix as the app; scan Start Menu links after install; require a native manifest wrapper. Needed before V3 installer-apps.

title: Hold launcher, clipboard, audio, chooser and input integration
justification: 1.0 gate: integration requirements hold for every passing Windows entry (launcher, taskbar, notifications, clipboard, audio, file chooser, input, scaling, accessibility where the toolkit exposes it).

title: Research measured-boot integrity as an anti-cheat vendor signal
justification: Whether measured boot and kernel lockdown can substitute for anti-cheat kernel drivers. Honest input to gaming claims; lockdown makes those drivers impossible.

title: Capture Windows application crashes as native crash records
justification: V3 crash-reporting gate. OBS owns capture format; WIN maps Wine/Windows crashes (including minidump-shaped payloads) onto that format with prefix identity.

title: Map NT objects and handles onto native Objects and Capabilities
justification: §3 NT objects and Windows handles; §48 Objects path. Implements nt-semantics; native software never sees NT handles (§3 firewall).

title: Decide NT object-manager, async I/O, descriptor and section fidelity
justification: §48 ADR: which NT semantics are emulated and to what fidelity. ABI-@spike-nt-object-manager is input. Options: Wine's current NT layer; a documented subset; a native Object mapping per type.

title: Decide how Wine and Proton map onto native Objects
justification: V2 exit requires this architecture ADR. Options: Wine stays on Linux-personality syscalls with native UX chrome; unixlib replaced by Native ABI bindings; hybrid graphics/input native. Depends on wine-hosting.

title: Bridge OLE drag-and-drop onto native Capability-granting drops
justification: V2 gate uses native clipboard and file chooser; UIP-@unified-dnd-clipboard-types (GAP-0276) needs the Wine OLE side so a native drop grants a Capability, not a path.

title: Emit typed failure reasons when a PE binary cannot run
justification: REL GAP-0450 triage flow needs a personality-authored reason (anti-cheat, architecture, missing runtime) so a failed double-click is not silent. WIN owns the reason; REL owns the UX.

title: Load PE executables and DLLs inside the Windows personality
justification: §48 PE loading (EXE and DLL) for W1. Userspace only per userspace-emulation; fuzzed by pe-loader-fuzz.

title: Fuzz the PE loader without panic on malformed images
justification: V4 external audit of personalities needs a seasoned PE-parse fuzz target before V3 continuous fuzzing. Userspace loader only.

title: Accept the Windows personality scoping decision
justification: Hard cap: the only V0 Windows deliverable. Records Wine/Proton as the starting point, not a clone; forbids obvious VM, separate desktop and ordinary-case wizard; tracks gaming as a major staffed objective (§3, §48, §49, §56.2).

title: Write the Windows personality threat addendum for the external audit
justification: V4 external security audit of personalities. SEC owns the V0 threat model; WIN documents prefix isolation, PE parsing, GPU/CPU side channels and the §3 firewall for the auditor.

title: Isolate each Windows application in its own Component and prefix
justification: Per-application Wine prefix plus immutable Wine Packages and mutable prefix state; compatibility-default Capability set so one compromised game cannot read another app's files or credentials. PKG-@wine-prefix-packaging is the store layout.

title: Bound Windows services, tasks and autostart to Component lifecycle
justification: Windows background services, scheduled tasks and autostart entries live inside a prefix and die with the owning Component; no user-wide svchost.

title: Provide Windows process, thread, inheritance and job semantics
justification: §3/§48 CreateProcess, threads, handle inheritance, job objects. CMP-@decide-personality-process-mapping decides Component mapping; TSK owns Task mapping.

title: Ship a Proton-style per-application compatibility database
justification: §48 per-game/per-app compatibility configuration database consumed by launch and surfaced in UI; feeds REL's public corpus.

title: Export Corpus ratings in machine-readable form for third parties
justification: V4 gate: compatibility corpora and results published in machine-readable form; pass rates reproducible with published scenario scripts.

title: Package Windows runtime redistributables as prefix dependencies
justification: VC++ runtimes, .NET, WebView2, legacy DirectX as per-prefix Packages, not runtime downloads. Contents limited by clean-room-policy (wine-mono/gecko versus Microsoft bits).

title: Emulate the registry in per-application prefix storage
justification: §3 registry semantics; §48 per-application mutable prefix storage. Shared user-wide registry is forbidden by GAP-0232.

title: Reproduce Wine, DXVK and VKD3D-Proton builds bit-for-bit
justification: V4 reproducible-builds gate includes personality runtimes. BLD owns the verifier; WIN makes Wine/DXVK/VKD3D Packages reproduce on two builders.

title: Surface Wine and Proton version pinning in native UI
justification: PKG-@personality-runtime-pinning owns multi-version Packages; WIN surfaces per-application Wine/Proton pin in native UI for W1 titles.

title: Apply native per-display scaling to Windows personality Surfaces
justification: V2 W1 integration check scores scaling. Win32 DPI awareness mapped onto native per-display and fractional scale; GFX owns the Display, WIN owns the personality.

title: Launch Steam Proton titles through the Windows personality
justification: V2 gaming PoC: Steam client stays LNX (EXTRA-027); WIN launches the Proton prefix for W1 Steam titles so they are Windows personality Components, not an obvious extra desktop.

title: Record the Windows personality feature freeze for 1.x
justification: V4 feature freeze after RC1. Documents the Win32/NT subset, Wine/Proton versions and nongoals that 1.0 will support; not an L1 freeze.

title: Build the per-title Windows scenario harness
justification: Critique: per-title scenario harness at V1 so V2 W1 runs are mechanical. Emits rating, integration checks and artefacts BEN's B-027 harness consumes.

title: Publish per-title W2 reports with the public rating scale
justification: V3 gate: a public per-title report with the rating scale. REL GAP-0366/0451 own the community database; WIN authors the W2 results.

title: Map Windows toast and balloon notifications onto the native service
justification: Pulled from V3: V2 W1 integration check scores notifications. LNX GAP-0273 is the Linux half; WIN implements the Wine toast path with per-app grants.

title: Publish the unsupported-title statement for anti-cheat and DRM
justification: 1.0 compatibility gate: published statement of what is not supported (kernel-level anti-cheat, vendor DRM, Broken titles with reasons).

title: Publish an upstream-first policy for Wine, Proton, DXVK and VKD3D
justification: No long-lived Wine fork; patches go upstream first; LGPL corresponding-source for every modified Wine build shipped. Needed before V1 CI packages Wine.

title: Decide that Win32 emulation stays in userspace
justification: Answers whether NT-object or PE-loading emulation in the GPLv2 kernel conflicts with LGPL Wine. Options: all Win32/NT/PE in userspace; PE loader in-kernel; NT objects in-kernel. Constrains architecture before bring-up.

title: Verify 1.0 W3 thresholds and the working-day Windows game demo
justification: 1.0 demos: coverage proof (W3 dashboard) and a full working day including a Windows game with HDR and VRR.

title: Verify the V2 double-click .exe demo on a target machine
justification: V2 demo: double-click a Windows .exe from the file browser; native chrome, native file chooser, task switcher; no separate desktop or wizard.

title: Verify V3 W2 thresholds and the Windows game-on-laptop demo
justification: V3 demo: Windows game and Linux IDE on the AMD laptop, on battery, with Bluetooth headset. Wires w2-gate evidence to the milestone demo.

title: Verify V4 W3 thresholds and Gold-hold on the beta fleet
justification: V4 compatibility gates wired to verifying tasks: W3 thresholds, W2 Gold-hold, machine-readable export.

title: Integrate VKD3D-Proton for Direct3D 12 translation
justification: §56.2 D3D12 via VKD3D-Proton. Split from DXVK so D3D12 regressions do not block D3D11 W1 titles.

title: Schedule Windows personality frames onto compositor VRR
justification: V2 gaming PoC and W1 Gold HDR/VRR exercise. Frame scheduling stays in GFX; WIN presents on the VRR path.

title: Define the W1 Corpus and rating scale
justification: Critique: define W1 before the V2 gate. 50 titles (35 games without kernel-level anti-cheat, 15 productivity) with Platinum/Gold/Silver/Bronze/Broken scenarios in registers/corpora.md.

title: Run the W1 Corpus to the V2 Gold and Silver thresholds
justification: V2 compatibility gate: 50 titles, ≥50% Gold, ≥70% Silver, integration checks (taskbar, launcher, notifications, clipboard, audio, file chooser, gamepad). BEN publishes B-027; WIN records ratings.

title: Define the W2 Corpus of 150 titles and scenario scripts
justification: V3 compatibility gate: windows-W2.md, 150 titles (110 games without kernel anti-cheat, 40 applications).

title: Run the W2 Corpus to the V3 Gold and Silver thresholds
justification: V3 gate: ≥60% Gold, ≥80% Silver; meaningful Windows compatibility. BEN re-measures B-027 on W2 Gold titles.

title: Hold zero Gold-to-lower regressions on W2 entries versus V3
justification: V4 compatibility gate: zero Gold-to-lower regressions on W2 entries versus V3.

title: Extend input, audio, HDR and VRR passthrough across the W2 Corpus
justification: V2 built the paths for the PoC; V3 W2 Gold titles must exercise them. INV-0913 completeness at public-alpha quality.

title: Define the W3 Corpus of 300 titles and scenario scripts
justification: V4 compatibility gate: windows-W3.md, 300 titles (220 games without kernel anti-cheat, 80 applications).

title: Run the W3 Corpus to the V4 Gold and Silver thresholds
justification: V4 gate: ≥70% Gold, ≥85% Silver, per-title public reports, third-party-reproducible scenario scripts.

title: Hold W3 Gold and Silver thresholds with zero V4 Gold regressions
justification: 1.0 compatibility gate: W3 ≥70% Gold and ≥85% Silver on Tier 1; zero Gold-to-lower versus V4. BEN republishes B-027.

title: Map WASAPI and XAudio2 onto native low-latency audio Objects
justification: §56.2 gaming audio. AUD owns INV-0925 and native objects; WIN maps WASAPI/XAudio2. No latency number in prose; AUD/BEN publish B-028.

title: Decide 32-bit Win32 support and WoW64 requirements
justification: Critique: V1 32-bit adr. Win32/WoW64 only; kernel ia32 retention is LNX EXTRA-028. Options: 32-bit Win32 in 1.0; 64-bit-only; 32-bit via VIRT fallback.

title: Survey Win32 APIs required by the W1 productivity set
justification: Critique W1 definition: 15 productivity applications. Report lists APIs, COM, installers and runtimes the V2 win32-surface and redistributables tasks must enable.

title: Expose the Win32 API surface required by the W1 Corpus
justification: §3/§48 Win32 for Windows applications. Enable Wine's Win32 for W1; not a clean-room reimplementation (INV-0894).

title: Package Wine and Proton runtimes as immutable Packages for CI
justification: Critique V1 Wine-on-LNX bring-up needs content-addressed Wine/Proton Packages. PKG owns INV-0541 and wine-prefix-packaging; WIN produces the runtime Packages CI installs.

title: Decide whether Wine hosts on the Linux personality or the Native ABI
justification: Critique: V1 non-gated architecture adr. Options: Wine over the Linux personality; Wine ported onto the Native ABI; hybrid (graphics and input native, remainder on Linux). Depends on wine-hosting-overhead.

title: Measure Wine-on-Linux-personality translation overhead
justification: Feeds the hosting adr. Runs a fixed game set under Wine on the Linux personality and estimates native-ABI port cost; publish-only, no superiority claim (B-027 is BEN).

title: Bring Wine up on the Linux personality
justification: Critique: V1 non-gated Wine-on-LNX bring-up. A PE binary starts under Wine hosted by the Linux personality; no V1 pass-rate gate.

title: Integrate Wine and Proton as the Windows personality core
justification: V2 scope: Win32/NT via Wine/Proton-derived layer as a product, not a V1 feasibility spike. Native software still sees no Win32 (§3).

title: Publish the V1 Wine test-suite feasibility report
justification: V1 compatibility gate: a feasibility report on running Wine's test suite under the Linux personality, with no pass-rate gate.

title: Run the Wine test suite in CI as a non-gated V1 bring-up signal
justification: Critique: Wine bring-up and Wine tests are non-gated at V1; W1 gates start at V2. WIN owns the suite; BLD hosts runners.

title: Enable 32-bit Win32 binaries under the Windows personality
justification: Implements win32-32bit. Many W1 games are 32-bit; depends on LNX ia32 retention. Dropped if the adr chooses 64-bit-only.

title: Map XInput, DirectInput, raw input and force feedback
justification: V2 gaming PoC requires gamepad input. HW owns devices; WIN maps XInput/DirectInput/raw/FF onto native input objects.
